"""Dataset-level fragility analysis: bootstrap SE, per-pair k*, null simulation, random baselines."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sp
import btlib as B


class Prepared:
    """A comparison data set aggregated on its pair graph."""

    def __init__(self, d, min_models_n=0):
        self.name, self.design, self.names = d["name"], d["design"], d["names"]
        self.M = len(self.names)
        g, cnt, inv, sa = B.Graph.from_comparisons(self.M, d["ci"], d["cj"], d["s"])
        self.g, self.cnt, self.N = g, cnt, int(cnt.sum())
        otype = np.where(sa == 1.0, 0, np.where(sa == 0.0, 1, 2))
        self.cell = inv * 3 + otype  # type index of every comparison
        self.cluster = pd.factorize(d["cluster"])[0]  # compact ids: empty clusters would shrink the resampled size
        self.ncl = int(self.cluster.max()) + 1
        self.Cmat = sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(self.cell)), (self.cluster, self.cell)), shape=(self.ncl, 3 * g.P))
        self.theta, self.H = B.fit(g, cnt, return_H=True)
        self.tie_rate = cnt[:, 2].sum() / cnt.sum()

    def counts_from_weights(self, Wb):
        """cluster-multiplicity matrix (B x ncl) -> counts (B, P, 3)"""
        return (sp.csr_matrix(Wb) @ self.Cmat).toarray().reshape(Wb.shape[0], self.g.P, 3)

    def bootstrap_theta(self, nboot, rng, by="cluster"):
        n = self.ncl if by == "cluster" else len(self.cell)
        out = np.empty((nboot, self.M))
        for b in range(nboot):
            if by == "cluster":
                w = rng.multinomial(self.ncl, np.full(self.ncl, 1.0 / self.ncl))
                cb = (self.Cmat.T @ w).reshape(self.g.P, 3)
            else:
                cb = rng.multinomial(self.N, (self.cnt / self.N).ravel()).reshape(self.g.P, 3).astype(float)
            out[b] = B.fit(self.g, cb, theta0=self.theta)
        return out

    def fisher_cov(self):
        return np.linalg.inv(self.H)

    """Parametric-bootstrap data: same graph and n_ij, scores from the fitted BT, mean score preserved exactly.

    P(a wins)=p-t/2, P(b wins)=1-p-t/2, P(tie)=t with t=min(tie_rate, 2 min(p,1-p)); p = fitted mean score.
    """
    g = P.g
    p = B.sigmoid(P.theta[g.pa] - P.theta[g.pb])
    n = P.cnt.sum(1).astype(int)
    t0 = P.tie_rate if tie == "global" else P.cnt[:, 2] / np.maximum(P.cnt.sum(1), 1)
